description: Read where your deferred x402 voucher series stands: what your newest voucher promised, what Last Price delivered, what the issuer has redeemed, what is still owed, when the voucher expires and the last redemption. Pass the 32 byte voucher_id you picked for the series and the buyer address that signs it. Use it to see what you owe before you sign the next voucher; vouchers are redeemed in hourly batches, for delivered calls only. Public: needs no credential, limited per address. Until it is switched on it answers not released.

buyer.description: The address that signs the vouchers.

voucher_id.description: The 32 byte voucher id of the series, as 0x hex.

name: get_x402_voucher_status
